rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body region (lines 1-100) carries no dated/biography markers; the 2026-08-01 correction notes and 2026-07-09/2026-07-26 stamps all sit below the maintainer cut (line 101), out of scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 voice quintet honored: Boris-direct phase mechanics ("the failure has a true-false answer"), Martin-style frame moves (Phase 2's reverse-align), no atmospheric misfires, no retain-this wrapper, no slang, no negation-callout contradiction.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a student-facing exercise, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body names shapes ("Background-agent verifier", "Deterministic shell-hook", "Ralph re-feed") without inline attribution, but body line 19 explicitly defers naming to the closing lecture ("The closing lecture names what you built afterward"), and the maintainer block carries the Boris Cherny / Huntley credit chain, satisfying the rule's maintainer-notes-otherwise clause. No creator-name, no author-we, timing placed correctly on line 3.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No maintainer-only terms (self-compound, substrate, three-pattern, grill-me) appear in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Governs how the student's in-session reference artefact is authored, not this file's own body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body names no practitioner at all (attribution deferred to maintainer + closing lecture), so the one-mention cap is not at risk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No flag phrases ("not an aspirational X", "vendor", "the real practitioners", etc.) in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File sits at M5 in the AE101 arc; terms used (verifier, reference artefact, plan.md, context rot, drift) are established curriculum vocabulary by this point, and "Ralph re-feed" is earned inline ("Loop the prompt with a check baked in; agent re-runs against its own output until the check passes").

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function. / Pronoun/metaphor-referent check is NOT post-trim-gated — fires on ANY closer.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Recap closer (line 97) anchors "Each piece" cleanly to the three named artefacts. Line 99's "once the contrast lands" is a definite noun phrase (not a pronoun/demonstrative) referring forward to the closing lecture named on line 19; doesn't match this rule's literal pronoun/demonstrative or spatial-metaphor shape.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Past tense for exercise recap sections — heading and body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "**What happened:**" heading (canonical) with past-tense body: "You ended the exercise with...", "Each piece proved its place..."

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All section headers (Phase 1-4, "Pin each failure...", "Prove the verifier actually fires", "Check both files are for the agent, not you", "Approve") are literal command-verb descriptions of what the section does.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No "you already think"/"you're missing" framing, no ability-level pegging; pre-flight check ("Confirm the path is right") is plausibly failable at this point.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M5-arc file: bare M1/M3/M5/M6 abbreviations fine (past M2). "Ralph re-feed" earned inline in Phase 3's shape menu.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule is scoped to Agents 101 default; this file's training is AE101 (engineering audience, worktrees, shell-hooks, Boris Cherny verifier-shape framework).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "Drift and context rot fire mid-run, on every spec re-read or window fill" uses context/rot correctly, no memory/context conflation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body.
Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompt bodies are referenced via {{prompt:...}} includes, not inlined in this file; prompt-shape rules are evaluated on the registry entries, not here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Debrief is owned by the module file per the maintainer's "Send-off mechanism" note; this exercise file doesn't contain the Debrief shape.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 90's "Push back if the reference reads like generic long-running advice" is a task-substance/fit judgment call requiring the student's own domain knowledge, not a technical-error spot-check delegable to Claude self-audit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a self-study simulation.

Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
